content: PH Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) requires informed, specific, documented consent before commercial SMS/email; contact info collected for one purpose (e.g. inquiry) cannot be reused for marketing without fresh consent. NPC breach notification within 72 hrs. Fines 500k-4M PHP, possible imprisonment. NTC separately requires pre-registered alphanumeric Sender ID for SMS (SEC/DTI, business permit, BIR 2303, proof of address) — unregistered sender IDs get filtered/blocked by telcos.
